text: In [example-svd-nonsquare], we found the singular value decomposition $$A=\begin{bmatrix} 2 \amp -2 \amp 1 \\ -4 \amp -8 \amp -8 \\ \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 \amp 1 \\ -1 \amp 0 \\ \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 12 \amp 0 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 3 \amp 0 \\ \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 1/3 \amp 2/3 \amp 2/3 \\ 2/3 \amp -2/3 \amp 1/3 \\ 2/3 \amp 1/3 \amp -2/3 \\ \end{bmatrix}^T\text{.} $$ Since there are two nonzero singular values, $\rank(A) =2$ so that the reduced singular value decomposition is $$A=\begin{bmatrix} 2 \amp -2 \amp 1 \\ -4 \amp -8 \amp -8 \\ \end{bmatrix} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 \amp 1 \\ -1 \amp 0 \\ \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 12 \amp 0 \\ 0 \amp 3 \\ \end{bmatrix} \begin{bmatrix} 1/3 \amp 2/3 \\ 2/3 \amp -2/3 \\ 2/3 \amp 1/3 \\ \end{bmatrix}^T\text{.} $$
